# Repositories tagged and released alongside a tapstate release.
#
# Read twice per release, by two different workflows: once to create the release branch in each, and
# once -- after tapstate's own release is published -- to tag that branch and publish a release
# pointing back at tapstate. Keeping the list here rather than in either workflow is what stops the
# two from disagreeing; a repository present in one reader and absent from the other gets a branch
# and never gets a tag, and nothing reports it.
#
# A satellite release carries no notes of its own. Its body links to the tapstate release, which is
# where what changed is written.
#
# One owner/repo per line. Blank lines and # comments are ignored. An empty list is refused rather
# than treated as "there are none".

tapstate/tapstate-web
tapstate/tapstate-skills
tapstate/docs
